fields.name: ParameterMapAttributeBase property mapping attribute
fields.contract: ParameterMapAttributeBase is an abstract property attribute that may be inherited and repeated on one property. Each instance supplies one property-to-database mapping: an implementation must decide whether a candidate CLR type is supported and must contribute the expressions needed for input parameters, output-parameter setup, output-value reading, and data-reader value reading. The base surface exposes the mapping names, provider-specific type code and optional record-identifier role to those operations.
